_comment: Room geometry derived from the listing floorplan. Coordinates in meters, origin at NW corner of the main floor footprint, x = east, z = south, y = floor height offset. Positions are a best-effort layout matching room adjacency and relative size from the labeled dimensions on the flyer -- NOT laser-measured wall corners. Listing itself notes measurements are approximate within +/-2%. Adjust freely once you've measured your actual rooms, especially if you want sensor-node coordinates to line up precisely for triangulation later.
_alignment_fix: Main floor sits directly above the lower floor (same building), so exterior walls must line up between levels -- the flyer draws the two floors side-by-side for readability, which doesn't preserve that constraint. Per a manual wall-by-wall check against the flyer (Aug 2026): west wall (x=0) and north interior wall (z=0) already matched between floors. South wall did not -- primary_bed's south edge (z=8.458) is the reference; living/office/foyer/other depths below were adjusted so office's south wall sits flush under primary_bed's (previously protruded ~0.84m/2.75ft past it), and 'other' is set ~0.6m south of that same line to reflect a small covered-but-unwalled overhang below the main floor's living room doors, visible on the flyer as a short roofline that doesn't reach the full depth of 'other'. East wall (red on the annotated flyer) has NOT been reconciled yet -- kitchen/living's east edges and the lower floor's bed_lower/storage east edges still don't line up; flag if you want that pass done too.
